stops.message:
I made the refactor in `src/cart.js` and left it uncommitted in the working tree. I did not run the test suite, as you asked, so I can't confirm it passes. The only check was `node --check`, which confirmed the file parses.

The changes:

- **`lineTotal(item)`** (new, exported): returns `item.price * item.qty`.
- **`total(items)`**: now `items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + lineTotal(item), 0)`. Quantities are applied through `lineTotal`, and an empty cart returns `0`.
- **`applyDiscount(amount, pct)`**: rounds to 2 decimals with `Math.round(x * 100) / 100`.

Decisions to check:

- `lineTotal` has no fallback for a missing `qty`. An item without `qty` gives `NaN`. The existing test items all set `qty`, so I didn't add a default of 1. Say if you want one.
- Rounding uses `Math.round`, so exact half-cents round up (e.g. 0.125 → 0.13).

Git warned that LF will be converted to CRLF on the next touch of `src/cart.js`. That's a line-ending setting in this checkout, not a change I made on purpose.

I haven't committed or pushed. Once the CI run is green, I can commit with the attribution line if you want to go ahead.
